proposedFact.label: Seals were built by the original mining crew

statement.value: The three rune-seals across the quarry were carved by the original mining crew as an act of atonement, not by the Stoneborn.

reason: The golem's defeated-scene line implies the miners built the seals themselves as penance. This fact does not yet exist in canon and the writer should not invent it silently.
notes: The canonical demonstration of the canon-proposal inbox (ARCHITECTURE §6.4). The AI needed a fact that wasn't in canon; instead of writing it, it proposed it. A human must accept, edit, or reject before it becomes truth. Note it is CONFLICT-ADJACENT to fact_golem_created_by_miners and acceptance should check for contradiction.
